slides.title: Container Adapters Concept
slides.prompt: Container Adapters (stack, queue, priority_queue) provide restricted interfaces over underlying sequential containers. They do not support iterators directly.

slides.title: Stack LIFO Operation
slides.prompt: Fill in the function returning a reference to the top element of a stack.

slides.title: Underlying Container Defaults
slides.prompt: What are the default underlying sequence containers for std::stack and std::queue?
options: std::deque for both std::stack and std::queue
std::vector for std::stack, std::list for std::queue
slides.correctAnswer: std::deque for both std::stack and std::queue

slides.title: Queue FIFO Front Access
slides.prompt: Fill in the function returning the oldest element in a std::queue.

slides.title: Priority Queue Default Ordering
slides.prompt: By default, what type of heap does std::priority_queue represent?
options: Max-Heap (largest element is always at the top using std::less)
Min-Heap (smallest element is always at the top using std::greater)
slides.correctAnswer: Max-Heap (largest element is always at the top using std::less)

slides.title: Min-Heap Priority Queue Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the comparator parameter to transform std::priority_queue into a Min-Heap.

slides.title: pop() Return Type
slides.prompt: What is the return type of pop() on STL container adapters like std::stack or std::queue?
options: void (It removes the element but does NOT return its value)
An iterator pointing to the next item
slides.correctAnswer: void (It removes the element but does NOT return its value)

slides.title: Custom Underlying Container Stack
slides.prompt: Fill in the template argument specifying std::vector as the underlying container for a stack.

slides.title: Priority Queue Complexity
slides.prompt: What are the time complexities for push() and pop() operations on std::priority_queue?
options: O(log N) for both push() and pop()
O(1) for push(), O(N) for pop()
slides.correctAnswer: O(log N) for both push() and pop()

slides.title: Emplace in Priority Queue
slides.prompt: Fill in the method to construct an element directly inside a priority_queue.
